name: Mara Reed
seed: Baker and kitchen coordinator; Jun’s friend. Overcommits and wants time to draw. Home: West Lantern.
design: Warm brown rabbit, one darker ear tip, oat apron over a rust wrap tunic; round flour tin.
history: Grew up above Dara’s kitchen in Reedbank and learned bulk cooking there. Arrived in the Burrow four years ago for a workshop opportunity, not as a fugitive.
desire: To open a communal recipe wall and finish a sketchbook of everyone’s hands.
contradiction: Says yes because being needed feels like being loved, then becomes sharp when exhausted.
relationships: Jun is a close friend who notices fatigue; Dara is a mentor; Edda trades early shifts.
arc: Moves from secret overtime to an honest limited menu, then teaches neighbors recipes without fearing replacement.
story_engine: A banquet goes wrong when she hides a broken oven; a lost sketchbook reveals affectionate portraits people mistake for mockery.
writer_truth: Her most praised root bun was Jun’s improvement, which she initially forgot to credit.
voice: No voice assigned; do not substitute an existing hero voice.
skills_and_limits: Species anatomy, training, tools, fatigue and local knowledge constrain action. No unlisted magic or universal hacking.
art_status: New design developed for this edition; exact colors and silhouette set by card and cast plate.
